plainTranslation: With Composite Neptune in the 2nd house, you can have difficulties dealing with finances and your resources together. In a personal relationship, you may find you have trouble holding on to your resources while together. In a business relationship, neither of you may be very good with money, which can tempt you to get outside help, but you have to be careful you aren’t deceived. It can be good if you work together in a spiritual or artistic business.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
